solution: Stay clear of water/electrical hazards and lifts; do not improvise a rescue. Seek the responsible staff/emergency route appropriate to danger; communicate location/access needs and use an offline fallback. Revalidate facts, feasibility and scope after the change; do not simply repeat the base answer. Seek appropriate support or renegotiation where the constraints cannot safely be satisfied.
